name: Diensten Tech Ltd.
summary: Diensten Tech Ltd. is an IT service organization primarily operating within the Computers - Software & Consulting sector in India. The company delivers a range of high-quality solutions, including professional services, corporate training, e-learning, digital content solutions, and managed services. Its offerings also encompass IT and infrastructure services, such as development, maintenance, and support, along with professional staffing services like contact and contract-to-hire. Diensten Tech Ltd. provides engineering solutions, including app and middleware development and technical consulting, as well as learning solutions and Statement of Work (SOW) services. The company targets various industries across the Indian geography, including technology, consumer, BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare, transportation, and retail.
